name: renovate-desk
description: Renovate pull requests (GitHub) or merge requests (GitLab) across your repos, sorted by what is safe to merge, merged in one keypress

forge.title: Forge
forge.description: github or gitlab. Left empty, the origin of the repo the session is in says which: GitLab when its host has gitlab in it, GitHub otherwise. Name it for a GitLab of your own under another host, or to look at one forge from a repo on the other.

query.title: Which pull requests (GitHub)
query.description: GitHub search qualifiers naming the Renovate pull requests to look after, added to: is:pr is:open archived:false. For example author:app/renovate org:acme, or author:app/renovate user:@me org:acme.

gitlabAuthor.title: Renovate's username (GitLab)
gitlabAuthor.description: The GitLab username Renovate opens its merge requests as. Every open merge request of that user you can see is looked after.
